nodes.label: FE-01 Frontend Foundation
nodes.rationale: The first milestone establishes React, Vite, Tailwind, routing, layout, an environment-configured Axios client, contract-based fixtures, and accessible mock-backed routes before dependent features are attempted.

nodes.label: AI Auctioneer
nodes.rationale: The AI Auctioneer is visibly labeled as AI, acts as a companion, and does not decide the winner.

nodes.label: AuctionContext
nodes.rationale: AuctionContext is the single source of truth for displayed auction state.

nodes.label: Defer Socket.IO and AI Panel
nodes.rationale: Socket.IO and the AI panel should not be started first because both depend on authentication, room state, and the backend contract.

nodes.label: Accessible Reusable Components
nodes.rationale: Reusable components should provide large touch targets, visible focus states, and status cues that do not rely on color alone.

nodes.label: Explicit Real-Time Status
nodes.rationale: Live status, connection state, version or resynchronization state, loading, and errors must be visible to make real-time behavior understandable.

nodes.label: Responsive Live Auction Layout
nodes.rationale: Desktop uses three columns for product information, price and bidding, and AI or history, while mobile prioritizes price, countdown, and a sticky bid action with Info, Bid, and AI tabs.

nodes.label: Server-Authoritative Bidding
nodes.rationale: The displayed price should not be updated optimistically before the server accepts a bid.

nodes.label: Backend and Database as Source of Truth
nodes.norm_label: backend and database as source of truth

nodes.label: Graphify Workflow
nodes.rationale: Codebase questions should begin with scoped Graphify query, path, or explain operations so the relevant subgraph is inspected before broader reports or raw source.

nodes.label: Dirty Graph Output Tolerance
nodes.rationale: Dirty graphify-out files are expected after hooks or incremental updates and should not prevent use of the graph.

nodes.label: Graph Update After Code Changes
nodes.rationale: Running graphify update after code changes keeps the AST-derived knowledge graph current without API cost.

nodes.label: Scoped Subgraph Navigation
nodes.rationale: Scoped query results are preferred because they are usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw search output.
